selector.champion: Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block)
selector.rationale: Evidence of first-degree AV block, right bundle-branch block, and left anterior fascicular block supports trifascicular heart block, with progression to complete heart block explained by third-degree AV block observed in 24-hour ECG monitoring.

rejected.label: Pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: Although present, it does not directly explain syncope and exercise intolerance as well as conduction abnormalities do.

rejected.label: Lev Cardiac Conduction Disease
rejected.why: Less specific than trifascicular block given the presence of first-degree AV block and bifascicular block.

rejected.label: Heart Block
rejected.why: Too broad; trifascicular block is more specific and explains the findings better.

rejected.label: Cardiac Amyloidosis
rejected.why: No direct evidence provided in the vignette to support this diagnosis over conduction system abnormalities.

rejected.label: High-degree atrioventricular block
rejected.why: While present, it is a component of trifascicular block, making the latter a more comprehensive explanation
